mapper.sql: id, user_id, education, major, grade, work_years, current_job, target_job_id, interest_tags, weekly_hours, phone_enc, email_enc, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_profile WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_profile (user_id, education, major, grade, work_years, current_job, target_job_id, interest_tags, weekly_hours, phone_enc, email_enc) VALUES (#{userId}, #{education}, #{major}, #{grade}, #{workYears}, #{currentJob}, #{targetJobId}, #{interestTags}, #{weeklyHours}, #{phoneEnc}, #{emailEnc})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_profile SET education = #{education}, major = #{major}, grade = #{grade}, work_years = #{workYears}, current_job = #{currentJob}, target_job_id = #{targetJobId}, interest_tags = #{interestTags}, weekly_hours = #{weeklyHours}, phone_enc = #{phoneEnc}, email_enc = #{emailEnc}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
